item.title: CVE-2026-110927 · 4.3 MEDIUM — Openssh: openssh: a compressed payload can expand past the maximum packet size
item.description: A flaw was found in OpenSSH. After compression is negotiated, a compressed payload can expand past the maximum supported packet size because the inflate loop does not stop at that limit. Memory use grows in the process handling that connection.

item.title: CVE-2026-110924 · 4.8 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Openssh: openssh: gssapi delegated credentials can be stored after a failed authentication
item.description: A flaw was found in OpenSSH. With GSSAPI authentication enabled, a failed GSSAPI attempt can leave delegated credentials stored for the connection even though user authorization did not succeed. A later successful login on that connection is not auth…

item.title: CVE-2026-110926 · 5.3 MEDIUM — Openssh: openssh: shared lz77 compression dictionary leaks plaintext across channels
item.description: A flaw was found in OpenSSH. When compression is negotiated, channels on the same connection share one LZ77 dictionary. A peer who can write on one channel can recover plaintext from another channel by chosen-plaintext lengths.

item.title: CVE-2026-110925 · 5.4 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Openssh: openssh: '$' and '\' in a command-line username expand through %u
item.description: A flaw was found in OpenSSH. A username entered on the ssh command line can still contain '$' or a non-trailing backslash. When a configuration expands %u inside ProxyCommand or Match exec, those characters are passed into the shell.

item.title: CVE-2026-110923 · 6.5 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Openssh: openssh: sftp can write outside the destination directory from a server-supplied path
item.description: A flaw was found in OpenSSH. During an sftp copy, a malicious server can supply an empty name, a slash-only path, or a ".." basename that sftp uses as the local destination, writing outside the directory the user selected.

item.title: CVE-2026-86849 · 6.5 MEDIUM — Dpdk: dpdk: integer overflow combined with missing validation leads to host buffer overflow in vhost-crypto
item.description: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost vhost-crypto. Integer overflow in chain length checks, and missing length checks on the RSA path, can overflow a host buffer in the vhost-crypto backend.

item.title: CVE-2026-86856 · 6.5 MEDIUM — Dpdk: dpdk: stack and heap buffer overflow in nfp vdpa driver
item.description: A flaw was found in the DPDK nfp vDPA driver. Stack and heap buffers sized for a single queue pair can be overflowed when more virtqueues are configured, leading to a host crash or memory corruption.

item.title: CVE-2026-86847 · 6.5 MEDIUM — Dpdk: dpdk: guest can trigger infinite loop in vhost-crypto writeback chain cleanup
item.description: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost vhost-crypto. Write-back chain cleanup can follow an uninitialized next pointer when mapping a guest descriptor fails, causing the host vhost-crypto process to hang or crash.

item.title: CVE-2026-86846 · 6.5 MEDIUM — Dpdk: dpdk: guest can trigger out-of-bounds write by controlling avail ring index in vhost-crypto
item.description: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost vhost-crypto. A guest can supply an avail-ring descriptor index that is used without bounds checking, causing an out-of-bounds write in the host vhost-crypto backend.

item.title: CVE-2026-86845 · 6.5 MEDIUM — Dpdk: dpdk: guest-triggered use-after-free and type confusion in vhost-crypto session cleanup

item.title: CVE-2026-86566 · 6.5 MEDIUM — Dpdk: dpdk: guest with runt rx descriptors underflows copy length in vhost enqueue (split and packed rings)
item.description: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost. A guest with runt RX descriptors can underflow the copy length in vhost enqueue, causing a denial of service in a shared vhost backend such as OVS-DPDK.

item.title: CVE-2026-86848 · 8.8 HIGH — Dpdk: dpdk: time-of-check/time-of-use vulnerability allowing guest-triggered out-of-bounds write in vhost-crypto
item.description: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost vhost-crypto. The indirect-descriptor snapshot double-fetches a guest descriptor next index, allowing a malicious guest to cause an out-of-bounds access in the host backend.

item.description: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost. The VDUSE handler fails to invalidate vring pointers when the IOTLB is invalidated, leading to use-after-unmap.

item.description: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost. A guest can desynchronize virtqueue size from inflight descriptor table size, causing an out-of-bounds write in the host vhost process.

item.title: CVE-2026-86563 · 7.8 HIGH — Dpdk: dpdk: double offset bug in vhost log mapping calculation
item.description: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost. A double-offset bug in vhost log mapping calculation can lead to incorrect memory access.

item.title: CVE-2026-86562 · 7.8 HIGH — Dpdk: dpdk: control-queue descriptor double-fetch overflows host heap in dpdk vhost (vduse)
item.description: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost. A TOCTOU double-fetch of control-queue descriptors allows a heap buffer overflow with attacker-controlled content in the VDUSE control-queue handler.

item.title: CVE-2026-86561 · 6.5 MEDIUM — Dpdk: dpdk: missing memory size validation before mmap in vhost memory region setup
item.description: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost. Memory size is not adequately validated before mmap during vhost memory-region setup, which can lead to a host crash or memory corruption.
